title: MZ Character Creation and Things like that.

posts.author: Cold
posts.body: So, I'm pretty newish to the RPGMaker scene, I've fiddled with the program a lot when I was younger but only with the trials and just recently got the program as a gift. Ive been having the concept for a game ive been wanting to make but it would require not only having a character creation screen for it, but also randomly created npcs with their own variables for species, personality, and maybe more if i come to understand it all better, along the lines of Rimworld-like or Sims-like game. I know thers characters creators out there that i can use for a plug in but im looking for something i can use my own art with and make something more similar to a visual novel which means the npcs randomly created and the player would need to be set up in a way where everything plays into eachother? I hope im making sense, im honestly like 60 percent sure i might need to code something like that in but im lost on where to start with something like that.

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
If you are just getting started, honestly, don't go that route yet. Character Creations plugin are usually complicated to setup and use. And they also may not do entirelly what you want.
I do have one, but it is paid:
Hakuen Studio Character Generator For RPG Maker MZ by Hakuen Studio
A new scene to create your own characters graphics!
hakuenstudio.itch.io
There is another one from an author called Mokusei Penguim, it's free, but don't know where to download.
[EDIT] There you go:
キャラクターメイク | ペンギンの寝床
